# The Mad Lions

> The Mad Lions is a film production house based in Athens, Greece, led by producer and film director Alex Konstantinidis. It makes commercials, music videos, feature and short films, documentaries, corporate films and stage visuals, and finishes them in house at Aibsent Studios, its post-production and AI studio. One team from the first idea to the final master. Contact: info@themadlions.com

- Website: https://themadlions.com/ (English) · https://themadlions.com/el/ (Greek)
- Email for new projects: info@themadlions.com (answers within a working day)
- Making films since 2016
- Based in Athens, Greece; shoots wherever the film needs to be
- Languages: English, Greek
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/themadlions/ · YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoPMSQpUYXNPSCMJV-ErfiA · Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/themadlions/

## Services
- **Commercials**: TV and online spots, from the first idea to the final master.
- **Music Videos**: A concept built around the song and the artist, shot like a short film.
- **Feature Films**: Feature and short films, from script and development to the final cut.
- **Documentaries**: Real people and real stories, filmed and edited with an honest eye.
- **Corporate Films**: Brand films, events and campaigns that show what a company does.
- **Visuals**: Stage and concert visuals, LED content and VJ loops that move with the music.
- **Post-production**: Editing, grading, VFX and motion graphics, for our films or for yours.

Aibsent Studios (post-production and AI): Editing, Color grading, Visual FX, Motion graphics, Compositing.

## How a production runs
1. **Idea**: We listen, then come back with a concept, a treatment and a clear budget.
2. **Pre-production**: Script, casting, locations, crew, schedule: every detail settled before the first day.
3. **Shoot**: A tight crew and the right gear, on set or on location, wherever the film needs to be.
4. **Post-production**: Edit, color, sound, graphics and effects, with you in every review.
5. **Delivery**: Masters for TV, cinema and every social format, on time.

## Clients
Brands and labels: Visa, L'Oréal, UNESCO, Aperol, Nescafé, Tresemmé, Axe, Wind, Germanos, Enerwave, Εθνική Ασφαλιστική, AbbVie, Janssen, Gree, Loumidis, Media Strom, Christodoulou, Softex, Panik Records, Heaven Music, Universal Music, Rythmos FM, Dromos FM, Stoiximan.

## Questions
### What does The Mad Lions do?
The Mad Lions is a film production house. We make commercials, music videos, feature and short films, documentaries, corporate films and stage visuals, and finish them in house at Aibsent Studios, our post-production and AI studio. One team takes a film from the first idea to the final master.

### Who is behind The Mad Lions?
The studio is led by producer and film director Alex Konstantinidis, with a team of assistant directors, filmmakers, editors, set designers and production assistants, and trusted crews for every shoot.

### Which brands and artists have you worked with?
Brands such as Visa, L’Oréal, UNESCO, Aperol, Campari, Nescafé, Tresemmé, Axe, Wind, Stoiximan and Gree, and artists such as Michalis Hatzigiannis, Helena Paparizou, Antonis Remos, Nikos Oikonomopoulos, Natasa Theodoridou and Melisses, with Panik Records, Heaven Music and Universal Music.

### How much does a commercial or a music video cost?
It depends on the idea, the shoot days, the cast and the post-production. We make films on budgets from under €5k to over €50k. Tell us yours and we come back with a concept, a treatment and a clear budget.

### Can you finish a film we shot ourselves?
Yes. Aibsent Studios, our post-production and AI studio, takes on editing, color grading, visual effects, motion graphics and compositing for films shot by others, and makes films with AI.

### Where do you shoot?
Wherever the film needs to be: in a studio or on location, with a tight crew and the right gear. We deliver masters for TV, cinema and every social format.

### How long does a production take?
It depends on the film. A commercial or a music video usually takes three to six weeks from the first call to the final master: about a week for the concept and pre-production, one to three shoot days, then one to three weeks of post-production. When it is urgent, we plan it to move faster.

### How do we start a project with you?
Write a few lines through the form on this page or to info@themadlions.com: what you are making, when you need it and your budget. We answer within a working day.

## Ερωτήσεις (Greek)
### Τι κάνουν οι The Mad Lions;
Οι The Mad Lions είναι εταιρεία κινηματογραφικής παραγωγής. Φτιάχνουμε διαφημιστικά, βίντεο κλιπ, ταινίες μεγάλου και μικρού μήκους, ντοκιμαντέρ, εταιρικές ταινίες και visuals για τη σκηνή, και τα ολοκληρώνουμε μόνοι μας στην Aibsent Studios, το δικό μας studio για post-production και AI. Μία ομάδα από την πρώτη ιδέα ως το τελικό master.

### Ποιος είναι πίσω από τους The Mad Lions;
Το studio το οδηγεί ο παραγωγός και σκηνοθέτης Alex Konstantinidis, με ομάδα από βοηθούς σκηνοθέτη, κινηματογραφιστές, μοντέρ, σκηνογράφους και βοηθούς παραγωγής, και σταθερά συνεργεία για κάθε γύρισμα.

### Με ποια brands και καλλιτέχνες έχετε δουλέψει;
Με brands όπως Visa, L’Oréal, UNESCO, Aperol, Campari, Nescafé, Tresemmé, Axe, Wind, Stoiximan και Gree, και με καλλιτέχνες όπως Μιχάλης Χατζηγιάννης, Έλενα Παπαρίζου, Αντώνης Ρέμος, Νίκος Οικονομόπουλος, Νατάσα Θεοδωρίδου και Μέλισσες, με την Panik Records, τη Heaven Music και τη Universal Music.

### Πόσο κοστίζει ένα διαφημιστικό ή ένα βίντεο κλιπ;
Εξαρτάται από την ιδέα, τις μέρες γυρίσματος, το cast και το post-production. Φτιάχνουμε ταινίες με budget από κάτω από €5k ως πάνω από €50k. Πείτε μας το δικό σας και επιστρέφουμε με concept, treatment και ξεκάθαρο budget.

### Μπορείτε να ολοκληρώσετε μια ταινία που γυρίσαμε εμείς;
Ναι. Η Aibsent Studios, το δικό μας studio για post-production και AI, αναλαμβάνει μοντάζ, color grading, visual effects, motion graphics και compositing για ταινίες που γύρισαν άλλοι, και φτιάχνει ταινίες με AI.

### Πού γυρίζετε;
Όπου χρειάζεται η ταινία: σε studio ή σε location, με δεμένο συνεργείο και τον σωστό εξοπλισμό. Παραδίδουμε masters για TV, σινεμά και κάθε social format.

### Πόσο χρόνο παίρνει μια παραγωγή;
Εξαρτάται από την ταινία. Ένα διαφημιστικό ή ένα βίντεο κλιπ συνήθως θέλει τρεις με έξι εβδομάδες από το πρώτο τηλεφώνημα ως το τελικό master: περίπου μία εβδομάδα για το concept και την προπαραγωγή, μία με τρεις μέρες γυρίσματος και μετά μία με τρεις εβδομάδες post-production. Όταν βιάζεστε, το σχεδιάζουμε να τρέξει πιο γρήγορα.

### Πώς ξεκινάμε ένα project μαζί σας;
Γράψτε μας λίγες γραμμές από τη φόρμα αυτής της σελίδας ή στο info@themadlions.com: τι θέλετε να φτιάξετε, πότε το χρειάζεστε και το budget σας. Απαντάμε μέσα σε μία εργάσιμη.

## Other pages
- [Aibsent Studios](https://themadlions.com/aibsent/): the studio's post-production and AI studio, for its films and for others'
- [The Mad Lions Lab](https://themadlions.com/lab/): the tools and apps the studio builds between films
- [RoarMe](https://themadlions.com/roarme/): the messenger for teams by The Mad Lions
- [Roardino](https://themadlions.com/lab/roardino/): the shoot's call sheet in one link, with directions, weather, sunrise and sunset, calls by department and the day in the crew's calendar
- [RoarMail](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarmail/): the private mail app for Mac and Windows
- [RoarList](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarlist/): the shot list with a frame for every shot
- [RoarWriter](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarwriter/): screenwriting from the page to the shoot: nine formats (film, TV, sitcom, stage play, musical, audio drama, AV two-column, comic) in English and Greek, revisions and versions, a breakdown, a beat board, a storyboard and shot list, a stripboard shooting schedule, TV series with their bible, writing together, an AI that reads the whole script (coverage, continuity, budget pass, pitch package, translation), PDF, Final Draft, Fade In and Fountain, on Mac, Windows, the web and the phone
- [RoarKit](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarkit/): one app, sixteen tools for the computer and the shoot (RoarTwin until October 2026): a score for the computer and what needs care first; a space map, clean up of program caches and of finished projects' render and proxy media; duplicate files and the same video or sound in another file; card copies to several drives at once, read back byte for byte, with an ASC MHL; backup checks; media reports, clip check and contact sheets as PDF; clip renaming with Undo; a two-pane file manager with media info; ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR archives; drive health and disk speed with the codecs a drive can take; computer stats with an internet speed test; a password vault with 2FA, sealed on the computer; only to the Trash; Mac and Windows
- [RoarMorph](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarmorph/) (Roarverter until October 2026): converts and compresses pictures, videos and sound on your own computer: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, PSD, EXR, camera RAW on a Mac; MP4 in H.264, H.265 or AV1, WebM, MOV, MKV, MPG; for the edit ProRes (Proxy to 4444), DNxHR (LB to 444), MXF, XDCAM, FFV1; MP3, WAV 24-bit, AIFF, ALAC, FLAC; a LUT, HDR to Rec.709, reframing to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 2.39:1, anamorphic desqueeze, loudness to −14, −16 or −23 LUFS; a target file size or bitrate with two passes, trims, stills, GIFs and a GIF to video; nothing is uploaded; Mac and Windows
- [RoarPlay](https://themadlions.com/lab/roarplay/): plays every video and every sound file on your own computer: ProRes, DNxHR, MXF, MKV, AVI, MPEG-2, H.264, HEVC, VP9, AV1, GIF; WAV, AIFF, FLAC, ALAC, AAC, MP3, Ogg, Opus, AC3, DTS; what the computer cannot decode is made playable on the fly, nothing written to disk; the file's own timecode (drop-frame too), J K L, one frame with the arrows, in and out and loop, the frame on screen saved as a PNG from the original, the file's facts (codec, profile, frame rate, colour, sound), every sound track, a queue; subtitles inside the file or beside it, speed 0.25x to 4x with the pitch kept, chapters, aspect masks and zoom, equalizer and output device, picture in picture, M3U; Resolume DXV, HAP, NotchLC, image sequences (DPX, EXR, PNG, DNG), web links; meters and EBU R128 loudness, scopes (waveform, parade, vectorscope, histogram), GOP and bitrate, a QC report (black, frozen, silence, missing frames, decode errors), a .cube LUT, compare two files, rating and markers as CSV or Resolve EDL; camera RAW named with the tool that opens it; English and Greek; free for Mac and Windows
- [RoarTransfer](https://roartransfer.com/about/): send large files free and secure at roartransfer.com, up to 5 GB with one short link, by email or link, with a password
